name: getstack
description: Reads stack slot values from a Lua stack frame. Without a numeric index, returns all stack values as a one-based table. With an index, returns the single stack slot value.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Stack level number converted to an integer. Must be in range 0 <= level < current call stack depth.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Optional one-based stack slot index. When provided, the single value at that stack slot is returned.
